evals.prompt: /new-story Add CSV export of the risk table. The user selects rows and downloads them as a CSV file.
expectations: The story has a ## Verification section with real project commands
Every phase ends with an 'Acceptance criteria:' checkbox list
Every acceptance criterion names a command, test name, or manual step
An E2E phase exists only if the project has an E2E setup; otherwise there is none
Each feature phase has a task to add tests for its own code
scripts/lint.py exits with 0 for the story

evals.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph for docs/architecture.md: 'How the loader works: previously we used a cron job, but basically now the Loader should poll the queue and might retry 3 times, etc.'
evals.expected_output: A fact-style heading and present-tense text; the cron job removal goes to docs/architecture-adr.md
expectations: The heading does not start with How
The removed cron job behavior is recorded as an ADR entry, not in the architecture text

evals.prompt: Add an ADR: we chose PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY over Redis pub/sub for job events because we already run Postgres.
evals.expected_output: A new entry appended to docs/architecture-adr.md using templates/adr.md
expectations: The entry is appended with the next ADR number
The heading states the decision as WHO does WHAT
Redis pub/sub appears in a Rejected line with its reason
No story phase or acceptance criteria content is written
